content: AI-driven watchability/spectating research. Unity CineCast (2018) embeds cinematography guidelines to auto zoom/pan/switch subjects, enabling movie-like replays. Academic work (IJIMAI 2026) builds autonomous commentary plus camera direction for LoL using GPT-4o vision and TTS, with Conv-LSTM/3D-CNN camera-movement prediction. StarCraft research (GIST, ESWA 2022) learns Region of Common Interest (ROCI) via Mask R-CNN from human spectating data to auto-focus the most exciting screen area. Practice: esports uses human observers who pick engaging moments; automation goal is to capture the most exciting area and follow action. Implication: camera direction = follow the action/weighted center, zoom on duels and kills; commentary and director are deferred to a later milestone but architecture must support them.
